name: Banh uot thit nuong
summary: Hot grilled meat rolled in soft wet rice paper with herbs, cucumber, star fruit, and green banana, then dipped. Some stalls grill pork on lemongrass skewers for a dip of soybean paste, peanuts, sesame, and chili; others roll grilled beef with a rich, mildly hot peanut sauce.
origin: Hoi An, where stalls line the Hoài river.
howToEat: Stack grilled pork from lemongrass skewers with salad, herbs, cucumber, and star fruit, wrap it in wet rice paper, and dip it in soybean paste with peanuts, sesame, fish sauce, and chili.
Some stalls roll grilled beef instead and serve a rich, mildly hot peanut-butter sauce.
Hot meat, Trà Quế herbs, green banana, and cucumber are the usual filling; the dip runs from sweet to salty-sweet, with a little peanut and chili.
seoTitle: Banh uot thit nuong — Hoi An grilled rolls
seoDescription: Bánh ướt thịt nướng in Hoi An is a roll you build: grilled pork or beef, herbs, and wet rice paper, dipped in a peanut sauce.
